target_customer: Ambitious high school students and their parents, who pay per accredited credit; also teachers via the founder's earlier grading tool
problem: Traditional high school takes four years and delivers a transcript; Units offers AI-led mastery lessons and accredited credits so students can finish faster and build a portfolio of real work.
business_model: Free lessons, paid accredited credits at $1,000 per official Ontario credit (per the company site)

founders.name: Daniel Martinez
education: Left high school early (per YC bio)
previous_startups: VibeGrade (AI grading tool for Google Classroom and Canvas, launched April 2025)
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he has built things since age 6 or 7. A launch post names a college dropout friend, Musa, as a co-founder of the earlier VibeGrade, but the Units YC page lists a team of 1.

competitors.name: Alpha School
competitors.what: Private AI-assisted school model using about 2 hours of adaptive software a day plus adult guides
competitors.traction_then: About a dozen campuses reported across 2025-26; first high school class graduated in 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly lesson content, an AI coaching layer on top of existing models and a registered private school partner; the hard part is accreditation and operations rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Accredited credits through a Ministry-inspected Ontario private school are a barrier of sorts, but the AI lesson layer is copyable and Alpha School-style models were already public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found against Units as of the sources reviewed.

market_need_then: Parents and students were questioning the value of school in an AI era and Alpha School drew heavy press in 2025; the company frames it as rebuilding school for a post-AGI world. No Units-specific demand data found.

identity.mascot_or_character: AI learning coach named Gilbert (per company site)
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, future-facing mission language (rebuilding school for a post-AGI world)

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself found; a branding search returned nothing relevant.

outcome_analysis: Units is an early stage, one person company from Spring 2025 that is still active. No outcome events, shutdown or acquisition were found in a search. Its fate depends on whether paid credits sell, and whether it can differentiate from Alpha School style models.
notes: No Units funding found. Aggregators say the founder's separate VibeGrade raised about 500K USD pre-seed (vcbacked, pitchbook snippets), unverified and not recorded as a round. Batch listed as Spring 2025 in the directory while some sources show P25; unresolved.
